prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for golden dandelion root tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with deep golden-brown roasted dandelion tea, placed slightly off-center (lower left). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: two small dandelion blossoms (bright sunshine yellow), one stem with serrated jagged leaves (sage green), and a few roasted dandelion root chips (dark amber, crisp). The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Dandelion blossoms and jagged leaves have confident silhouettes, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle amber glazed rim. Warm noon light from upper left casts a faint shadow below the cup. Feels grounded, liver-supportive, coffee-substitute. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
